{{Top|leg}}
'''Executive order 2354''' was a specific [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] order concerning [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]]. It advised all [[operative]]s to avoid the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] at all costs. [[Deke Holman]] informed [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]] about the order when he uncovered information on Brandl while searching for information on his son, [[Jaalib Brandl]].
